files.description: This module makes all Onshape Standard Library features and functions available.
This module makes most common Onshape Standard Library functions available. It can be imported in place of geometry.fs,

entries.name: Context
entries.description: A Context is a builtin that stores modeling data, including bodies (solids, sheets, wires, and points), their constituent topological entities (faces, edges, and vertices), variables, feature error states, etc.

entries.name: canBeContext
entries.description: Typecheck for Context

entries.name: isAtInitialMixedModelingReleaseVersionOrLater
entries.description: Returns true if at or after mixed modeling release version.

entries.name: Id
entries.description: An Id identifies a feature or operation in a context. Each feature, subfeature, and operation must have a unique id. Ids are used in queries, error reporting, and accessing data associated with features.

entries.name: canBeId
entries.description: Typecheck for Id

entries.name: newId
entries.description: Returns an empty id.

entries.name: makeId
entries.description: Returns an id specified by the given string.

entries.name: isTopLevelId
entries.description: True if the Id represents a top-level feature or default geometry (i.e. if the Id has length 1)

entries.name: ANY_ID
entries.description: The string literal "*", which matches any id inside certain queries.

entries.name: unstableIdComponent
entries.description: Marks a given id component as "unstable" causing queries to treat it as a wildcard. This is useful for when the id component is not expected to be robust, such as an index into the results of an evaluated query.

entries.name: setVariable
entries.signature: (context is Context, name is string, value)
entries.description: Attach a variable to the context, which can be retrieved by another feature defined later. If a variable of the same name already exists, this function will overwrite it.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Can be any value, including an array or map with many elements.

entries.name: setVariable
entries.signature: (context is Context, name is string, value, description is string)
entries.description: Attach a variable with a description to the context, which can be retrieved by another feature defined later. If a variable of the same name already exists, this function will overwrite it.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Can be any value, including an array or map with many elements.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: A string describing the use or purpose of the variable.

entries.name: getVariable
entries.description: Retrieve a variable attached to the context by name. Throws an exception if variable by the given name is not found.

entries.name: getVariable
entries.signature: (context is Context, name is string, defaultValue)
entries.description: Retrieve a variable attached to the context by name. If variable by the given name is not found, returns defaultValue

entries.name: libraryLanguageVersion
entries.description: Returns the language version of the library. Note: this function calls @getLanguageVersion internally, but if you call @getLanguageVersion directly, you may get a different result. That is because @getLanguageVersion returns the language version of the module making the call (which, for a module in std will coincide with the version of std.)

files.description: Operations are the basic modeling primitives of FeatureScript. Operations can do extrusion, filleting, transforms, etc. An operation takes a context, an id, and a definition and modifies the context in accordance with the definition. The modifications can be referenced by the passed-in id. Operations return undefined but can fail by throwing an error or they can report warnings or infos. The status can be read with the getFeature... functions in error.fs.

entries.name: opMoveCurveBoundary
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Trims or extends a wire body to an entity or by a distance.

parameters.name: wires
parameters.description: The wire bodies to modify.

parameters.name: trimTo
parameters.description: Required if moveBoundaryType is TRIM.Single entity to trim wires to.

parameters.name: endCondition
parameters.description: OptionalIf moveBoundaryType is EXTEND defines whether to extend wires by a distance of to an entity. Default is BLIND.

parameters.name: extensionDistance
parameters.description: Required if endCondition is BLINDDistance to extend wires.

parameters.name: extendTo
parameters.description: Required if endCondition is BLINDSingle entity to extend wires to.

parameters.name: extensionShape
parameters.description: OptionalSpecifies how to transition into the curve extensions. Default is SOFT.

parameters.name: helpPoint
parameters.description: Required if endCondition is BLINDSpecifies vertex used to choose a solution. If this is not provided, the closest vertex to the bounding entity will be used.

parameters.name: flipHeuristics
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, will trim or extend from the opposite end of wires. Default is false.

entries.name: opBodyDraft
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Apply draft to a part by adding material. The material is added between reference edges and a parting object. These reference edges can be supplied directly, or they can be inferred from face or part queries.

parameters.name: topEdges
parameters.description: Required if selectionType is EDGESEdges to draft above parting entity.

parameters.name: bottomEdges
parameters.description: Required if selectionType is EDGES and bothSides is trueEdges to draft with angleBelow.

parameters.name: faces
parameters.description: Required if selectionType is FACESFaces to draft. This will split the face with isoclines those for the draft. Additionally, any existing edges bounding faces will be used if they mark a transition from steep faces to non-steep faces for the given pull direction and draft angle.

parameters.name: bodies
parameters.description: Required if selectionType is PARTSParts to draft. This is equivalent to supplying all faces of the part in faces.

parameters.name: excludeFaces
parameters.description: OptionalFaces of bodies to exclude from drafting.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: The draft angle above the parting object.

parameters.name: bothSides
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, draft on both sides of the parting object. Default is false.

parameters.name: pullDirection
parameters.description: The pull direction.

parameters.name: draftOnSelf
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, then using the drafted part as the parting object. Default is false.

parameters.name: partingObject
parameters.description: Required if draftOnSelf is falseA surface from surfaceGeometry.fs or a query to a face or sheet body.

parameters.name: matchFacesAtParting
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, then additional material will be added to make the top and bottom of the draft align. Default is false.

parameters.name: concaveRepair
parameters.description: OptionalHow to resolve intersecting draft faces. Default is NONE.

parameters.name: concaveRepairRadius
parameters.description: Required if concaveRepair is RADIUS or MIX.The radius for intersection repair.

parameters.name: keepMaterial
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, an attempt will be made to keep the regions of the part protruding from the tapered faces. Default is false.

parameters.name: showRefs
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, then debug data will be generated to show the parting surface and draft edges.

entries.name: opBoolean
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Performs a boolean operation on multiple solid and surface bodies.

parameters.name: tools
parameters.description: The tool bodies.

parameters.name: targets
parameters.description: Required if OperationType is SUBTRACTION or SUBTRACT_COMPLEMENT, or if targetsAndToolsNeedGrouping is true.The target bodies.

parameters.name: targetsAndToolsNeedGrouping
parameters.description: OptionalThis option is for adjusting the behavior to be more suitable for doing the boolean as part of a body-creating feature (such as extrude). Default is false.

parameters.name: keepTools
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, the tools do not get consumed by the operation. Default is false.

parameters.name: makeSolid
parameters.description: OptionalIn case of surface union try to join surfaces into a solid. Default is false.

entries.name: opBoundarySurface
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Creates a boundary surface fitting two ordered sets of profiles.

parameters.name: uProfileSubqueries
parameters.description:
An ordered array of two or fewer queries for the profiles in the u direction. These can be edges or wire bodies. 
EXAMPLE
[ profileQuery1, profileQuery2 ]

parameters.name: vProfileSubqueries
parameters.description:
OptionalAn ordered array of two or fewer queries for the profiles in the v direction. These can be edges or wire bodies. 
EXAMPLE
[ profileQuery1, profileQuery2 ]

parameters.name: uDerivativeInfo
parameters.description:
OptionalAn array of maps that contain shape constraints at start and end profiles. Each map entry is required to have a profileIndex that refers to the affected profile. Optional fields include a vector to match surface tangent to, a magnitude, and booleans for matching tangents or curvature derived from faces adjacent to affected profile. 
EXAMPLE
[ { "profileIndex" : 0, "vector" : vector(1, 0, 0), "magnitude" : 2., "tangentToPlane" : true}, { "profileIndex" : 1, "adjacentFaces" : qFaces } ] The first map would constrain the resulting boundary surface at the first u profile to be tangent to plane with normal vector(1,0,0) and magnitude 2. The second map constrains the boundary surface at the second u profile to match tangents of faces defined by the query qFaces.

parameters.name: vDerivativeInfo
parameters.description: OptionalAn array of maps analogous to uDerivativeInfo, but for v profiles.

parameters.name: showIsocurves
parameters.description: OptionalShow graphical representation of a subset of isoparameteric curves on each face of the created boundary surface. Default false.

parameters.name: curveCount
parameters.description: OptionalWhen showIsocurves is true, the number of curves to draw in each direction of each face's grid. Default 10.

entries.name: opCreateBSplineCurve
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Generates a wire body given a BSplineCurve definition. The spline must have dimension of 3 and be G1-continuous.

parameters.name: bSplineCurve
parameters.description: The definition of the spline.

entries.name: opCreateBSplineSurface
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Generates a sheet body given a BSplineSurface definition. The spline must have dimension of 3 and be G1-continuous.

parameters.name: bSplineSurface
parameters.description: The definition of the spline surface.

parameters.name: boundaryBSplineCurves
parameters.description: OptionalAn array of BSplineCurves defined in the parameter space of bSplineSurface to use as the boundary of the created sheet body. The boundary must form a single closed loop on the surface. The dimension of each curve must be 2, as the boundaries are being defined in UV space of the created surface. If no boundary is supplied, the created sheet body will cover the full parameter range of bSplineSurface.

parameters.name: makeSolid
parameters.description: OptionalWhen set to true, the operation will produce a solid instead of a sheet if the surface encloses a region. Default is false.

entries.name: opCreateCompositePart
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Create a composite part.

parameters.name: bodies
parameters.description: Bodies from which to create the composite part. .

parameters.name: closed
parameters.description: OptionalA closed composite part consumes its constituent bodies, so that they are not available interactively for individual selection. Default is false.

entries.name: opModifyCompositePart
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Modifies a composite part.

parameters.name: composite
parameters.description: Existing composite part to modify.

parameters.name: toAdd
parameters.description: Bodies to add to the composite part.

parameters.name: toRemove
parameters.description: Bodies to remove from the composite part.

entries.name: opChamfer
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Adds a chamfer to given edges and faces.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: Edges and faces to chamfer.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description:
Required if chamferType is EQUAL_OFFSETS or OFFSET_ANGLE.EXAMPLE
0.2 * inch

parameters.name: width1
parameters.description: Required if chamferType is TWO_OFFSETS.

parameters.name: width2
parameters.description: Required if chamferType is TWO_OFFSETS.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: Required if chamferType is OFFSET_ANGLE.

parameters.name: oppositeDirection
parameters.description: Required if chamferType is OFFSET_ANGLE or TWO_OFFSETS.true to reverse the two edges.

parameters.name: tangentPropagation
parameters.description: Optionaltrue to propagate the chamfer along edges tangent to those passed in. Defaults to false.

entries.name: opConstrainedSurface
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Creates a constrained surface from the points.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: An array of maps containing: point (Vector) : The position of the point we want the surface to pass through. normal (Vector) (Optional) : The direction of the normal of the surface at this point.

parameters.name: tolerance
parameters.description: OptionalThe distance the surface is allowed to deviate from the given points. Default is 1e-6 meter.

parameters.name: smooth
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, the surface will be optimized for smoothness. If false, it will be optimized for performance. Default is false.

parameters.name: references
parameters.description: OptionalFor Onshape internal use.

entries.name: CurveOnFaceDefinition
entries.description: Describes a set of isoparametric curves on a face.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Description

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face the curves are meant to lie on.

parameters.name: names
parameters.description: An array of distinct non-empty strings to identify the curves created.

parameters.name: nCurves
parameters.description: Required if creationType is DIR1_AUTO_SPACED_ISO or DIR2_AUTO_SPACED_ISONumber of curves.

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: Required if creationType is DIR1_ISO or DIR2_ISOParameters to create curves at.

entries.name: canBeCurveOnFaceDefinition
entries.description: Typecheck for CurveOnFaceDefinition

entries.name: curveOnFaceDefinition
entries.signature: (face is Query, creationType is FaceCurveCreationType, names is array, nCurves is number)
entries.description: Returns a new CurveOnFaceDefinition.

entries.name: curveOnFaceDefinition
entries.signature: (face is Query, creationType is FaceCurveCreationType, names is array, parameters is array)

entries.name: opCreateCurvesOnFace
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Generates isoparametric curves of faces. That is, for each specified surface parameter value, creates a new wire body following the curve which keeps the surface parameter at that constant value.

parameters.name: curveDefinition
parameters.description: An array of CurveOnFaceDefinitions that describe group of curves per face.

parameters.name: showCurves
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to display isoparameteric curves in color in the preview.

parameters.name: skipTrim
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to skip trimming of curves by the face boundaries. Lines and arcs are always trimmed.

entries.name: opDeleteBodies
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Deletes bodies from the context.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: Entities to delete. Passing in entities other than bodies deletes their owning bodies.

entries.name: opDeleteFace
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: This is a direct editing operation that attempts to delete faces of a solid body and extend other faces to fill the hole.

parameters.name: deleteFaces
parameters.description: Faces to delete.

parameters.name: includeFillet
parameters.description: true to also delete fillets adjacent to the input faces.

parameters.name: capVoid
parameters.description: If capVoid is true and the deleted face cannot be filled by extending the surrounding faces, will attempt to replace the face with a planar face.

parameters.name: leaveOpen
parameters.description: OptionalIf leaveOpen is true the void from deleting faces is left open, potentially creating a surface out of a solid body. Default is false.

entries.name: opEnclose
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Takes in a set of bodies and faces and creates solid bodies for the enclosed regions.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: Bodies and faces for enclosure.

entries.name: opDraft
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Applies a given draft angle to faces.

parameters.name: draftFaces
parameters.description: Required if draftType is REFERENCE_SURFACE The faces to draft for a REFERENCE_SURFACE draft.

parameters.name: referenceSurface
parameters.description: Required if draftType is REFERENCE_SURFACE A face or plane that defines the neutral surface for a REFERENCE_SURFACE draft. draftFaces will remain unchanged where they intersect referenceSurface. Can be either a Query or a Plane.

parameters.name: referenceEntityDraftOptions
parameters.description: Required if draftType is REFERENCE_ENTITY An array of maps of the form ("face", "references", "angle"). "face" should be a Query for exactly one face. "references" should be a Query for at least one edge attached to the face. The "face" will be drafted while the geometry of the "references" remains unchanged. "angle" is an optional ValueWithUnits parameter between -89.9 and 89.9 degrees which overrides the default angle parameter.

parameters.name: pullVec
parameters.description:
The 3d direction relative to which the draft is applied. 
EXAMPLE
vector(0, 0, 1) .

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description:
The draft angle, must be between 0 and 89.9 degrees. 
EXAMPLE
3 * degree

parameters.name: tangentPropagation
parameters.description: OptionalFor a REFERENCE_SURFACE draft, true to propagate draft across tangent faces. Default is false.

parameters.name: referenceEntityPropagation
parameters.description: OptionalFor a REFERENCE_ENTITY draft, true to collect new reference entities and faces by pulling in edges connected to the specified reference edges. Connected edges on the same face or on tangent connected faces will be pulled in. Default is false.

parameters.name: reFillet
parameters.description: Optionaltrue to attempt to defillet draft faces before the draft and reapply the fillets after. Default is false.

entries.name: opExtractWires
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Generates wire bodies from the supplied edges. If the edges are disjoint multiple wires will be returned. If the edges overlap or cross, or more than two meet at a point, the function will fail.

parameters.name: edges
parameters.description: The edges to be extracted.

entries.name: opExtrude
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Extrudes one or more edges or faces in a given direction with one or two end conditions. Faces get extruded into solid bodies and edges get extruded into sheet bodies.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: Edges and faces to extrude.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description:
The 3d direction in which to extrude. 
EXAMPLE
evOwnerSketchPlane(context, {"entity" : entities}).normal to extrude perpendicular to the owner sketch EXAMPLE
evPlane(context, {"face" : entities}).normal to extrude perpendicular to the first planar entity

parameters.name: endBound
parameters.description:
The type of bound at the end of the extrusion. Cannot be SYMMETRIC or UP_TO_VERTEX. 
EXAMPLE
BoundingType.BLIND

parameters.name: endDepth
parameters.description:
Required if endBound is BLIND.How far from the entities to extrude. 
EXAMPLE
1 * inch

parameters.name: endBoundEntity
parameters.description: Required if endBound is UP_TO_SURFACE or UP_TO_BODY.The face or body that provides the bound.

parameters.name: endTranslationalOffset
parameters.description: OptionalThe translational offset between the extrude end cap and the end bound entity. The direction vector for this is the same as direction: negative values pull the end cap away from the bound entity when endDepth is positive. endOffset will only have an effect if endBound is UP_TO_SURFACE, UP_TO_BODY, or UP_TO_NEXT.

parameters.name: startBound
parameters.description: OptionalThe type of start bound. Default is for the extrude to start at entities. Cannot be SYMMETRIC or UP_TO_VERTEX.

parameters.name: isStartBoundOpposite
parameters.description: Required if is UP_TO_SURFACE, UP_TO_BODY, or UP_TO_NEXT.Whether the startBound extends in the opposite direction from the profile as the endBound. Defaults to true if not supplied.

parameters.name: startDepth
parameters.description: Required if startBound is BLIND.How far from the entities to start the extrude. The direction vector for this is the negative of direction: positive values make the extrusion longer when endDepth is positive.

parameters.name: startBoundEntity
parameters.description: Required if startBound is UP_TO_SURFACE or UP_TO_BODY.The face or body that provides the bound.

parameters.name: startTranslationalOffset
parameters.description: OptionalThe translational offset between the extrude start cap and the start bound entity. The direction vector for this is the negative of direction: negative values pull the end cap away from the bound entity when startDepth is positive. startOffset will only have an effect if startBound is UP_TO_SURFACE, UP_TO_BODY, or UP_TO_NEXT.

entries.name: opFaceBlend
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Performs a face blend between two walls of faces.

parameters.name: side1
parameters.description: First set of faces, must belong to the same body.

parameters.name: side2
parameters.description: Second set of faces, must belong to the same body.

parameters.name: flipSide1Normal
parameters.description: Wether to flip side 1's normal.

parameters.name: flipSide2Normal
parameters.description: Wether to flip side 2's normal.

parameters.name: propagation
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to propagate the blend.

parameters.name: propagationAngle
parameters.description: OptionalMaximum angle between faces for propagation. Used if propagationType is FaceBlendPropagation.CUSTOM. Default is 0 * radian.

parameters.name: crossSection
parameters.description: The cross section type of the blend.

parameters.name: spine
parameters.description: Required if crossSection is DISC.The spine of the blend. The blend's cross section will be orthogonal to the spine.

parameters.name: crossSectionShape
parameters.description: What shape the cross section of the blend will be.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Required if blendControlType is RADIUS.The radius of the cross section.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Required if blendControlType is WIDTH.The width of the blend.

parameters.name: asymmetric
parameters.description: OptionalWether the radius or width is the same on each wall.

parameters.name: secondRadius
parameters.description: Required if blendControlType is RADIUS and asymmetric is true.The radius of the cross section from side 2.

parameters.name: widthRatio
parameters.description: Required if blendControlType is WIDTH and asymmetric is true.How the blend will be divided between the walls. If widthRatio < 1, it will be wider towards side 1. If widthRatio > 1, it will be wider towards side 2.

parameters.name: rho
parameters.description: Required if crossSectionShape is CONICParameter of the conic cross section shape.

parameters.name: magnitude
parameters.description: Required if crossSectionShape is CURVATUREParameter of the curvature cross section shape.

parameters.name: tangentHoldLines
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to use the content of tangentEdges and inverseTangentEdges.

parameters.name: tangentEdges
parameters.description: OptionalEdges to use as tangent hold lines.

parameters.name: inverseTangentEdges
parameters.description: OptionalEdges to use as inverse tangent hold lines.

parameters.name: conicHoldLines
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to use the content of conicEdges and inverseConicEdges.

parameters.name: conicEdges
parameters.description: OptionalEdges to use as conic hold lines.

parameters.name: inverseConicEdges
parameters.description: OptionalEdges to use as inverse conic hold lines.

parameters.name: hasCliffEdges
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to use the content of cliffEdges.

parameters.name: cliffEdges
parameters.description: OptionalEdges to use as cliff edges.

parameters.name: hasCaps
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to use the content of caps.

parameters.name: caps
parameters.description: OptionalEntities and flip flags to use as caps. Each map should contain an entity Query element and a flip boolean element.

parameters.name: hasLimits
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to use the content of limitPlane1, limitPlane2, faceLimits and edgeLimit.

parameters.name: limitPlane1
parameters.description: OptionalFirst plane to limit the blend.

parameters.name: limitPlane1Flip
parameters.description: Whether to flip the first plane normal. Defines which side of the plane the blend will be.

parameters.name: limitPlane2
parameters.description: OptionalSecond plane to limit the blend.

parameters.name: limitPlane2Flip
parameters.description: Whether to flip the first plane normal. Defines which side of the plane the blend will be.

parameters.name: faceLimits
parameters.description: OptionalFaces to use as limits to the blend.

parameters.name: edgeLimit
parameters.description: OptionalEdges and adjacent faces to use as limits. Each map should contain an edge Query element and an edgeLimitSide query element.

parameters.name: hasHelpPoint
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to use the content of helpPoint.

parameters.name: helpPoint
parameters.description: OptionalVertex or mate connector to use as help point. In case the blend parameters create several blends, only the blend closest to the help point will be kept.

parameters.name: trim
parameters.description: OptionalHow to trim the blend.

parameters.name: detach
parameters.description: OptionalWhether not to attach the blend(s) to the sides, creating new sheet bodies.

parameters.name: showIsocurves
parameters.description: OptionalShow graphical representation of a subset of isoparameteric curves of the created surface. Default false.

parameters.name: curveCount
parameters.description: OptionalWhen showIsocurves is true, the number of curves to draw in each direction of the grid. Default 10.

entries.name: opFillet
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: For edges, performs a fillet on the edge. For faces, performs a fillet on all edges adjacent to the face.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: Edges and faces to fillet.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description:
The fillet radius. 
EXAMPLE
1 * inch

parameters.name: tangentPropagation
parameters.description: Optionaltrue to propagate the fillet along edges tangent to those passed in. Default is false.

parameters.name: crossSection
parameters.description: OptionalFillet cross section. One of CIRCULAR, CONIC, CURVATURE. Default is CIRCULAR.

parameters.name: rho
parameters.description:
Required if crossSection is CONIC.A number between 0 and 1, specifying the Rho value of a conic fillet 
EXAMPLE
0.01 creates a flat, nearly-chamfered shape. EXAMPLE
0.99 creates a pointed, nearly-unchanged shape.

parameters.name: magnitude
parameters.description: Required if crossSection is CURVATURE.A number between 0 and 1, specifying the magnitude of curvature match.

parameters.name: partialFilletBounds
parameters.description:
OptionalAn array of maps representing the boundaries of a partial fillet. Each map should contain a boundaryEdge query, a boundaryParameter value, a isFlipped boolean 
EXAMPLE
[{ "boundaryEdge" : edgeQuery0, "boundaryParameter" : 0.3, "isFlipped" : false }, { "boundaryEdge" : edgeQuery1, "boundaryParameter" : 0.6, "isFlipped" : true }]

parameters.name: isVariable
parameters.description: OptionalFillet controls can be varied at vertices via vertexSettings. Default is false.

parameters.name: vertexSettings
parameters.description:
OptionalAn array of maps representing fillet settings at specified vertices. Each map should contain a vertex query, a vertexRadius value, a variableMagnitude if the crossSection is FilletCrossSection.CURVATURE, and a variableRho if the crossSection is FilletCrossSection.CONIC. 
EXAMPLE
[{ "vertex" : vertexQuery0, "vertexRadius" : 1 * inch, "variableRho" : 0.2 }, { "vertex" : vertexQuery1, "vertexRadius" : 2 * inch, "variableRho" : 0.8 }]

parameters.name: pointOnEdgeSettings
parameters.description:
OptionalAn array of maps representing fillet settings at specified points on edges. Each map should contain an edge query, an edgeParameter value, a pointOnEdgeRadius value, a pointOnEdgeVariablMagnitude if the crossSection is FilletCrossSection.CURVATURE, and a pointOnEdgeVariableRho if the crossSection is FilletCrossSection.CONIC. 
EXAMPLE
[{ "edge" : edgeQuery0, "edgeParameter" : 0.3, "pointOnEdgeRadius" : 1 * inch }, { "edge" : edgeQuery1, "edgeParameter" : 0.6, "pointOnEdgeRadius" : 2 * inch }]

parameters.name: smoothTransition
parameters.description: Required if isVariable is true Whether to create a smoother transition between each vertex.

parameters.name: allowEdgeOverflow
parameters.description: OptionalAllow opFillet to modify nearby edges to maintain the fillet profile. Default is true.

parameters.name: keepEdges
parameters.description: OptionalEdges you do not want opFillet to modify if allowEdgeOverflow is true.

parameters.name: smoothCorners
parameters.description: OptionalAllow opFillet to smooth all suitable corners and prevent creation of sharp edges. Default is false.

parameters.name: smoothCornerExceptions
parameters.description: OptionalVertices you do not want opFillet to smooth if smoothCorners is true.

parameters.name: createDetachedSurface
parameters.description: OptionalOperation does not modify the body of the selected edges, but results in surface geometry of fillet. Default is false.

entries.name: opFillSurface
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Generates a surface body from supplied boundary and internal constraints. The boundaries are defined as edge queries for each continuity constraint. The internal constraints may be defined as a set of support vertices.

parameters.name: edgesG0
parameters.description: The edges with position constraints.

parameters.name: edgesG1
parameters.description: The edges with tangency constraints.

parameters.name: edgesG2

parameters.name: identities
parameters.description: OptionalAn array of queries, one per axis in axes, used to disambiguate each of the created holes. Each query should resolve to exactly one entity. Providing this information does not change the geometric outcome, but stabilizes references to the holes with respect to upstream changes to the model.

parameters.name: targets
parameters.description: Required if holeDefinition contains any profiles that do not reference HolePositionReference.AXIS_POINT, or if subtractFromTargets is true A set of bodies to target. entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Creates a surface or solid loft fitting an ordered set of profiles, optionally constrained by guide curves.

parameters.name: profileSubqueries
parameters.description:
An ordered array of queries for the profiles. For a solid loft, these must be sheet bodies, faces, or vertices. For a surface loft, these could be wire bodies, sheet bodies, faces, edges, or vertices. 
EXAMPLE
[ profileQuery1, profileQuery2 ]

parameters.name: guideSubqueries
parameters.description: OptionalAn array of queries for guide curves. Each guide curve should intersect each profile once.

parameters.name: connections
parameters.description:
OptionalAn array of maps to define multiple profile alignments. Each connection map should contain:
(1) connectionEntities query describing an array of vertices or edges (one per profile),
(2) connectionEdges an array of individual queries for edges in connectionEntities. The order of individual edge queries should be synchronized with connectionEdgeParameters.
(3) connectionEdgeParameters array - an ordered and synchronized array of parameters on edges in connectionEdgeQueries 
EXAMPLE
[ {"connectionEntities" : qVertexAndEdge1, "connectionEdges" : [qEdge1], "connectionEdgeParameters" : [0.25]} {"connectionEntities" : qVertexAndEdge2, "connectionEdges" : [qEdge2], "connectionEdgeParameters" : [0.75]}]

parameters.name: makePeriodic
parameters.description: OptionalDefaults to false. A closed guide creates a periodic loft regardless of this option.

parameters.name: trimGuidesByProfiles
parameters.description: OptionalIf false (default) use full length of guides. If true restrict resulting surface by the first and last profile. Meaningful only for non-periodic surface loft.

parameters.name: trimProfiles
parameters.description: OptionalIf false (default) use full length of profiles. If true restrict resulting surface by the first and last guide or connection. Meaningful only for surface loft with open profiles.

parameters.name: derivativeInfo
parameters.description:
OptionalAn array of maps that contain shape constraints at start and end profiles. Each map entry is required to have a profileIndex that refers to the affected profile. Optional fields include a vector to match surface tangent to, a magnitude, and booleans for matching tangents or curvature derived from faces adjacent to affected profile. 
EXAMPLE
[ { "profileIndex" : 0, "vector" : vector(1, 0, 0), "magnitude" : 2., "tangentToPlane" : true}, { "profileIndex" : 1, "matchCurvature" : true, "adjacentFaces" : qFaces } ] The first map would constrain the resulting loft at the start profile to be tangent to plane with normal vector(1,0,0) and magnitude 2. The second map constrains the loft at the end profile to match the curvature of faces defined by the query qFaces.

parameters.name: showIsocurves

parameters.description: OptionalWhen showIsocurves is true, the number of curves to draw in each direction of each face's grid. Default 10.

entries.name: opSplitByIsocline
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Split the given faces by isocline edges. Each isocline follows a path along a face with a constant angle in the (-90, 90) degree range (e.g., lines of latitude on a sphere). This angle is the face tangent plane's angle with respect to the direction with its sign determined by the dot product of direction and the face normal, and is analogous to the angle used in draft analysis. Depending on the face geometry, there may be zero, one, or multiple isoclines on each face. The isocline edges are created as new edges which split the provided faces. The resulting faces are either steep (i.e., the angle is less than the input angle) or non-steep. To instead leave the original faces intact, you can first extract the faces with opExtractSurface(), and create isoclines on the resulting surfaces. The isocline edges can be queried for with qCreatedBy. The split orientation is consistent such that the non-steep faces are always in "front" of the split, and can be reliably queried for with qSplitBy:

parameters.name: faces
parameters.description: The faces on which to imprint isoclines.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: A reference direction.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: The isocline angle with respect to the direction in the (-90, 90) degree range.

A shadow curve represents the transition of one face from visible to invisible. Depending on the geometry, there may be zero, one, or more shadow curves per face. The shadow curve edges are created as new edges which split the faces of the provided bodies. Each of the resulting faces is wholly visible or wholly invisible. Edge-on faces are considered invisible. The shadow curve edges can be queried for with qCreatedBy. The split orientation is consistent such that the visible faces are always in "front" of the split, and can be reliably queried for with qSplitBy:

entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Applies a given transform to one or more bodies. To make transformed copies of bodies, use opPattern.

parameters.name: bodies
parameters.description: The bodies to transform.

parameters.name: transform
parameters.description:
The transform to apply. 
EXAMPLE
transform(vector(0, 0, 1) * inch) will translate the body 1 inch along the world's z-axis. EXAMPLE
rotationAround(myLine, 30 * degree) will rotate around a Line object. EXAMPLE
scaleUniformly(factor) will scale uniformly about the origin. EXAMPLE
scaleUniformly(factor, point) will scale uniformly about a given point. EXAMPLE
toWorld(cSys) will (somewhat counterintuitively) perform a transform such that geometry on the world's origin and axes will move to the cSys origin and axes. EXAMPLE
fromWorld(cSys) will (somewhat counterintuitively) perform a transform such that geometry on the cSys origin and axes will move to the world origin and axes. EXAMPLE
transform2 * transform1 will perform transform1, followed by transform2.

entries.name: opWrap
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Wraps or unwraps faces from one surface onto another. The location and orientation of the wrapped faces on the destination surface are controlled by the anchorPoint and anchorDirection of the source and destination WrapSurfaces. The entities of the operation are not affected, the result of this operation is a new set of surface bodies or imprinted edges representing the wrapped or unwrapped faces. Faces that are topologically connected will remain topologically connected in the result body for WrapType.SIMPLE and WrapType.TRIM. This operation currently supports wrapping from a plane onto a cylinder or a cone, and unwrapping from a cylinder or a cone onto a plane.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: Faces to wrap from source to destination.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: The surface to wrap from. All entities must lie on this surface.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: The surface to wrap onto. Must be defined using the face field for WrapType.TRIM or WrapType.IMPRINT.

parameters.name: orientWithDestination
parameters.description: OptionalIf true (default), the normals of the resulting surface will point in the same direction as the destination. If false, the normals of the resulting surface will point in the opposite direction. For the purpose of this parameter, the normals of a WrapSurface defined by an infinite Cylinder are always pointing outwards.

files.description: Functions for constructing queries. Features that take queries as inputs should re-export this module.

entries.name: Query
entries.description: A Query identifies a specific subset of a context's entities (points, lines, planes, and bodies).

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Description

entries.name: canBeQuery
entries.description: Typecheck for Query

entries.name: BodyType
entries.description: Specifies the topological type of a body.

parameters.name: SOLID
parameters.type: A three-dimensional part (e.g. the result of a solid extrude)

parameters.name: SHEET
parameters.type: A two-dimensional sheet body (e.g. a sketch region, or the result of a surface extrude)

parameters.name: WIRE
parameters.type: A one-dimensional curve (e.g. a sketch line or curve, or the result of opHelix)

parameters.name: POINT
parameters.type: A zero-dimensional point (e.g. a sketch point, or the result of opPoint)

parameters.name: COMPOSITE
parameters.type: A composite part body, which can contain bodies of any other type

entries.name: EntityType
entries.description: Specifies the topological type of a given entity. Used in several queries as a filter, or on any query explicitly with qEntityFilter

parameters.name: EDGE
parameters.type: A one-dimensional line, curve, or edge

parameters.name: FACE
parameters.type: A two-dimensional surface, planar face, or non-planar face

parameters.name: BODY
parameters.type: A solid, surface, wire, or point body

entries.name: AdjacencyType
entries.description: Specifies the adjacency type of queried entities.

parameters.name: VERTEX
parameters.type: Entities share at least a vertex

parameters.name: EDGE
parameters.type: Entities share at least an edge

entries.name: GeometryType
entries.description: Specifies the geometric type of queried entities.

parameters.name: OTHER_CURVE
parameters.type: Any one-dimensional entity which is not described above (e.g. splines, ellipses, etc.)

parameters.name: PLANE
parameters.type: A construction plane or planar face

parameters.name: CYLINDER
parameters.type: A surface which forms the side of a right circular cylinder

parameters.name: CONE
parameters.type: A surface which forms the side of a right circular cone

parameters.name: SPHERE
parameters.type: A surface which forms the boundary of a sphere

parameters.name: TORUS
parameters.type: A surface which forms the boundary of a torus

parameters.name: REVOLVED
parameters.type: A surface constructed by revolving a curve around an axis (unless it is simplified to one of the types above)

parameters.name: EXTRUDED
parameters.type: A surface constructed by extruding or sweeping a curve along a line (unless it is simplified to one of the types above)

parameters.name: OTHER_SURFACE
parameters.type: Any two-dimensional entity which is not described above (e.g. the side of an arbitrary loft)

parameters.name: ALL_MESH
parameters.type: A surface or a body that is fully mesh or an edge between two mesh surfaces.

parameters.name: MIXED_MESH
parameters.type: A body that contains both mesh and non-mesh surfaces or an edge between a mesh and a non-mesh surfaces.

parameters.name: MESH
parameters.type: A surface that is mesh, a body that contains mesh surfaces or an edge bordering a mesh surface.

entries.name: CapType
entries.description: Specifies which cap queried entities should belong to.

parameters.name: START
parameters.type: finds entities belonging to the start cap

parameters.name: END
parameters.type: finds entities belonging to the end cap

parameters.name: EITHER
parameters.type: finds entities belonging to either cap

entries.name: ConstructionObject
entries.description: Specifies whether the entity was created for construction (e.g. a construction line or construction plane).

parameters.name: YES
parameters.type: Matches only entities which are created for construction

parameters.name: NO
parameters.type: Matches only entities which are not created for construction

entries.name: SMFlatType
entries.description: Specifies whether an entity appears in the sheet metal flat view, or the main view.

parameters.name: YES
parameters.type: Matches entities which belong to a flattened sheet metal part.

parameters.name: NO
parameters.type: Matches entities which do not belong to a flattened sheet metal part.

entries.name: SMFormType
entries.description: Specifies whether an entity is an artifact of a sheet metal form feature on flat pattern.

parameters.name: YES
parameters.type: Matches entities which are artifacts of a sheet metal form feature on flat pattern.

parameters.name: NO
parameters.type: Matches entities which are not artifacts of a sheet metal form feature on flat pattern.

entries.name: AllowMeshGeometry
entries.description: Specifies whether we allow meshes. Default is NO.

entries.name: AllowFlattenedGeometry
entries.description: Specifies whether we allow flat entities. Default is NO.

entries.name: ActiveSheetMetal
entries.description: Specifies whether the entities should belong to an active sheet metal model.

parameters.name: YES
parameters.type: matches only entities which belong to an active sheet metal model

parameters.name: NO
parameters.type: matches only entities which do not belong to an active sheet metal model

entries.name: SheetMetalDefinitionEntityType
entries.description: Specifies geometry corresponding to a certain type of topological entity in the sheet metal master body for active sheet metal models.

parameters.name: VERTEX
parameters.type: matches entities defined by a sheet metal master body vertex. This includes vertices, edges, and faces at the corners, bend ends, fillets, and chamfers of sheet metal models.

parameters.name: EDGE
parameters.type: matches entities defined by a sheet metal master body edge. This includes edges and faces along the sides of sheet metal walls.

parameters.name: FACE
parameters.type: matches entities defined by a sheet metal master body face. This includes faces of sheet metal walls.

entries.name: ModifiableEntityOnly
entries.description: Specifies whether we allow modifiable only entities. It is default to NO.

parameters.name: NO
parameters.type: Allow both modifiable and unmodifiable entities

entries.name: AllowEdgePoint
entries.description: Specifies whether we allow edge points. Default is YES.

entries.name: MeshGeometry
entries.description: Specifies whether the entities are mesh geometries.

parameters.name: YES
parameters.type: Matches only entities (edges, faces, and bodies) which are meshes

parameters.name: NO
parameters.type: Matches only entities (edges, faces, and bodies) which are not meshes

entries.name: SketchObject
entries.description: Specifies whether the entity is a part of a sketch.

parameters.name: YES
parameters.type: Matches only entities which are part of a sketch

parameters.name: NO
parameters.type: Matches only entities which are not part of a sketch

entries.name: QueryFilterCompound
entries.description: A set of convenience filters, which are expanded during precondition processing. Can be used as a filter on query parameters, just like their corresponding expansions:

parameters.name: ALLOWS_AXIS
parameters.type: Equivalent to GeometryType.LINE || GeometryType.CIRCLE || GeometryType.ARC || GeometryType.CYLINDER || BodyType.MATE_CONNECTOR and can be processed with evAxis

parameters.name: ALLOWS_DIRECTION
parameters.type: Equivalent to GeometryType.LINE || GeometryType.CIRCLE || GeometryType.ARC || GeometryType.CYLINDER || GeometryType.PLANE and can be processed with extractDirection

parameters.name: ALLOWS_PLANE
parameters.type: Equivalent to GeometryType.PLANE || BodyType.MATE_CONNECTOR and can be processed with evPlane

parameters.name: ALLOWS_VERTEX
parameters.type: Equivalent to EntityType.VERTEX || BodyType.MATE_CONNECTOR and can be processed with evVertexPoint

entries.name: CompareType
entries.description: Specifies a method of comparing two items.

entries.name: Consumed
entries.description: Specifies whether to filter or allow bodies (and their vertices, edges, and faces) consumed by closed composite parts.

parameters.name: YES
parameters.type: Matches only bodies that are consumed

parameters.name: NO
parameters.type: Matches only bodies that are not consumed

entries.name: CompositePartType
entries.description: Specifies whether to filter or allow closed or open composite parts.

entries.name: InContextObject
entries.description: Specifies whether an entity is from an assembly context.

parameters.name: YES
parameters.type: Matches only entities which are from an assembly context

parameters.name: NO
parameters.type: Matches only entities which are not from an assembly context

entries.name: qNothing
entries.description: An empty query, which does not resolve to any entities.

entries.name: qEverything
entries.description: A query for all entities of a specified EntityType in the context.

entries.name: qEverything
entries.description: A query for all entities in the context.

entries.name: qAllNonMeshSolidBodies
entries.description: A query for all solid bodies that do not have mesh geometry.

entries.name: qAllSolidBodies
entries.description: A query for all solid bodies.

entries.name: qAllModifiableSolidBodiesNoMesh

entries.name: qAllModifiableSolidBodies
entries.description: A query for all modifiable solid bodies, including mesh-containing bodies.

entries.name: qNthElement
entries.description: A query for one entity in queryToFilter at a specified index. The order of entities resolved by a query is deterministic but arbitrary.

parameters.name: queryToFilter
parameters.description: A query which resolves to at least n+1 entities

Zero-based index of entity in queryToFilter.
